en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from one of his men, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘You must not (derive) omens (prophecies) from the Quran (Fa’al)’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from certain individuals of his people from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
The Holy Quran is not to be used for omens or prophecy.’”
